name: GIN-Wallpaper-Calend
description: Smart Desktop Wallpaper with Calendar for Windows 10/11 (English by default, added Czech language support alongside English and Russian, ultra-minimal English-only installer dialog, completely silent uninstaller)
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev
features: English language by default for fresh installations
Full trilingual support: English (EN), Czech (CS / Čeština), Russian (RU) across all menus, calendar overlays, settings, and buttons
Minimal installer dialog in pure English: 'GIN-Wallpaper-Calend - Install?' with OK/Cancel buttons
Completely silent uninstallation: removes all binaries, autostart, shortcuts from desktop and Start menu with 0 popups
Soft organic double-drop bubble sound on update completion, ultra-low idle RAM footprint ~1.5-2 MB via WinAPI SetProcessWorkingSetSize
